[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311163/5256ac4d5b6883783602f04123ca9b3888ccad78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Go right ahead and wishlisht the game & try the demo:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3909740/Midnight_Saturn/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]A grizzled private eye in a sci-fi adventure takes a murder case no one else will touch. notes.title: Neon Hearts City is OUT!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Neon Hearts City, a fully-voiced cyberpunk-themed point and click adventure, is out! Go get it now! 

A private investigator, tracking a missing person, uncovers a conspiracy between humans and androids and a secret that could change everything. 

Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.

Have fun!

Yours, 
Cosmic Void

notes.title: Neon Hearts City is releasing on May 13th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Neon Hearts City - the cyberpunk-themed point and click adventure I've been working on - is releasing on May 13th, that's one month from now! The game is going to be published by Dionous Games. 

Make sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already & tell all your friends about it! :) 

All the best,
Cosmic Void
